advisories.guideline: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee (Directorate of PPQ&S, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare)
advisories.implementation: All active ingredients, crop registrations, and label claim rates listed conform to approved label registrations under the Insecticides Act, 1968.

advisories.guideline: Standard field spray rates for field and vegetable crops (PAU / ICAR recommendations)
advisories.implementation: Dosages are calculated based on high-volume knapsack/power sprayers using 150–200 Litres of water per acre (375–500 L/ha) for complete foliage coverage.

advisories.guideline: Statutory waiting period between the last chemical application and crop harvest
advisories.implementation: Mandatory for all food crops (especially vegetables like tomato, brinjal, chili) to ensure pesticide residue dissipates below statutory FSSAI Maximum Residue Limits (MRLs).

advisories.guideline: Surface tension reduction for waxy or upright foliage
advisories.implementation: Crops such as Onion, Garlic, Cabbage, and Cauliflower have heavily glaucous (waxy) foliage; non-ionic stickers (e.g. Triton, APSA-80 @ 0.5 ml/L) prevent runoff.

advisories.guideline: Fungicide & Insecticide Resistance Action Committee guidelines
advisories.implementation: Avoid more than two consecutive sprays of single-site systemic chemicals (e.g. Triazoles, Neonicotinoids). Rotate with multi-site contact protectors (Mancozeb, COC).

advisories.guideline: Preventative suppression of soil-borne vascular wilt and set-borne rot
advisories.implementation: For sugarcane (Red Rot) and guava (Wilt), preventative application via sett soaking or root-zone basin drenching is required, as foliar sprays cannot cure vascular vascular pathogens.
